portraits.name: Sakura Haruno (Part I)
portraits.usage: Roster, Team, Wiki and Summon tokens (56/40 px round, tier ring), the ult bar (46 px), the Ultimate cut-in, the boss intro card, the dialogue box, the Kage reveal

refs.label: Part I Naruto's portrait
refs.role: the framing and style reference ONLY: match its crop, head size in the frame, angle, line weight and cel shading exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit or colours

refs.label: this character's own sprite
refs.role: the same character: match the face, hair, outfit, colours and expression exactly, drawn as a close portrait

prompts.gemini:
Draw a head-and-chest portrait bust of Sakura Haruno for a 2D game, as a square 1:1 image.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 (Part I Naruto's portrait): the framing and style reference ONLY: match its crop, head size in the frame, angle, line weight and cel shading exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit or colours.
Image 2 (this character's own sprite): the same character: match the face, hair, outfit, colours and expression exactly, drawn as a close portrait.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: Sakura Haruno as a 12-year-old genin. Long straight pink hair to the shoulders, bright green eyes, a large forehead, a bright hopeful expression. She wears a red qipao-style dress with a white circle crest on the back and short sleeves, and a red cloth forehead protector with a metal forehead-protector plate engraved with the Hidden Leaf Village symbol (a spiral ending in a small triangular leaf flick) worn as a hairband on top of her head.
Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

POSE AND FRAMING: a head-and-chest portrait bust. Three-quarter view with the head turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face) and the eyes looking at the viewer. The torso is turned mostly toward the viewer so the top, jacket or shirt and its design are clearly shown. The WHOLE head and ALL of the hair fit inside the frame with a clear empty margin above the highest point and on both sides (no spike, ponytail or headband tail cut off). The crop ends at the lower chest. The head, chin to top of the skull, fills about one third of the image height, the same in every portrait.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid bright cyan background (#00FFFF), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep bright cyan out of the character.

CONSTRAINTS: one character only. Square 1:1 image (1024 x 1024). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no ground shadow, no floor line, no props unless described.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). CHARACTER: Shino Aburame as a 12-year-old genin, a mysterious boy. Bushy dark brown hair, round black sunglasses hiding his eyes, and a high grey collar of his jacket covering his mouth and nose. POSE AND FRAMING: a head-and-chest portrait bust. Three-quarter view with the head turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face) and the eyes looking at the viewer. The WHOLE head and ALL of the hair fit inside the frame with a clear empty margin above the highest point and on both sides (no spike, ponytail or headband tail cut off). The crop ends at the lower chest. The head, chin to top of the skull, fills about one third of the image height, the same in every portrait.

Image 2 (this character's own sprite): the same character: match the face, hair, outfit, colours and expression exactly, drawn as a close portrait.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: Yamato (Tenzo), an adult jonin of the Hidden Leaf (Shippuden). Short brown hair, dark almond eyes with a calm, slightly eerie stare. He wears a happuri-style metal face guard framing his face from the forehead down both cheeks, engraved with the Hidden Leaf symbol on the forehead, over a green Leaf flak vest and dark blue shirt.
Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

POSE AND FRAMING: a head-and-chest portrait bust. Three-quarter view with the head turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face) and the eyes looking at the viewer. The torso is turned mostly toward the viewer so the top, jacket or shirt and its design are clearly shown. The WHOLE head and ALL of the hair fit inside the frame with a clear empty margin above the highest point and on both sides (no spike, ponytail or headband tail cut off). The crop ends at the lower chest. The head, chin to top of the skull, fills about one third of the image height, the same in every portrait.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid magenta background (#FF00FF), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep magenta out of the character.

prompts.gemini:
Draw a head-and-chest portrait bust of Masked Beast for a 2D game, as a square 1:1 image.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 (Shippuden Naruto's portrait): the framing and style reference ONLY: match its crop, head size in the frame, angle, line weight and cel shading exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit or colours.
Image 2 (this character's own sprite): the same character: match the face, hair, outfit, colours and expression exactly, drawn as a close portrait.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: One of Kakuzu's masked beasts: a shadowy black mass of dark threads with a white tribal mask for a face, hollow eyes, and a gaping mouth; shown head-on.
Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

POSE AND FRAMING: a head-and-chest portrait bust. Three-quarter view with the head turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face) and the eyes looking at the viewer. The torso is turned mostly toward the viewer so the top, jacket or shirt and its design are clearly shown. The WHOLE head and ALL of the hair fit inside the frame with a clear empty margin above the highest point and on both sides (no spike, ponytail or headband tail cut off). The crop ends at the lower chest. The head, chin to top of the skull, fills about one third of the image height, the same in every portrait.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid magenta background (#FF00FF), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep magenta out of the character.

CONSTRAINTS: one character only. Square 1:1 image (1024 x 1024). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no ground shadow, no floor line, no props unless described.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 (Part I Naruto's sprite): the style and proportion reference ONLY: match its head size, line weight, cel shading and art style exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit, colours or pose details; the character below is a different person.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: Sakura Haruno as a 12-year-old genin. Long straight pink hair to the shoulders, bright green eyes, a large forehead, a bright hopeful expression. She wears a red qipao-style dress with a white circle crest on the back and short sleeves, and a red cloth forehead protector with a metal forehead-protector plate engraved with the Hidden Leaf Village symbol (a spiral ending in a small triangular leaf flick) worn as a hairband on top of her head.
Show the complete outfit exactly as the anime draws this character in this era, head to feet, including trousers or skirt and footwear. Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

PROPORTIONS: Sakura Haruno is 150 cm tall and drawn 4.4 heads tall (the head, chin to the top of the skull, not counting hair that sticks up, is 1/4.4 of the height from the soles to the top of the skull). The head is exactly as big as in Image 1; a taller character has a longer body and legs, not a bigger head. The build follows the anime (slim, broad, stocky or tall as the character is drawn there).

POSE AND FRAMING: full body, standing in a relaxed ready stance: feet apart, weight balanced, arms held slightly away from the body with loosely closed fists, so there is a clear gap between each arm and the hip. Three-quarter front view: the chest and shoulders face the viewer, the head and body turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face, the nose pointing right). Eye-level camera. The whole figure in frame from the top of the hair to the soles, centred, with a small even margin; feet at the bottom centre. Anything described as being on the back of the outfit is not visible from this angle: do not turn the character to show it.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid bright cyan background (#00FFFF), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep bright cyan out of the character.

CONSTRAINTS: one character only. Square 1:1 image (1024 x 1024). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no ground shadow, no floor line, no props unless described.

prompts.gemini:
Draw a full-body sprite of Gaara for a 2D game, as a square 1:1 image.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 (Part I Naruto's sprite): the style and proportion reference ONLY: match its head size, line weight, cel shading and art style exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit, colours or pose details; the character below is a different person.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: Gaara of the Sand as a 12-year-old. Short spiky dark red hair, pale sea-green eyes ringed with heavy dark circles, no eyebrows, the kanji for "love" (愛) carved in red on the left side of his forehead, a cold blank expression. He wears a black full-body outfit with a white sash across the chest holding a huge sand gourd on his back, and a a cloth forehead protector with a metal forehead-protector plate engraved with the Hidden Sand Village symbol (an hourglass shape) worn on the sash strap.
Show the complete outfit exactly as the anime draws this character in this era, head to feet, including trousers or skirt and footwear. Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

PROPORTIONS: Gaara is 148 cm tall and drawn 4.3 heads tall (the head, chin to the top of the skull, not counting hair that sticks up, is 1/4.3 of the height from the soles to the top of the skull). The head is exactly as big as in Image 1; a taller character has a longer body and legs, not a bigger head. The build follows the anime (slim, broad, stocky or tall as the character is drawn there).

POSE AND FRAMING: full body, standing in a relaxed ready stance: feet apart, weight balanced, arms held slightly away from the body with loosely closed fists, so there is a clear gap between each arm and the hip. Three-quarter front view: the chest and shoulders face the viewer, the head and body turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face, the nose pointing right). Eye-level camera. The whole figure in frame from the top of the hair to the soles, centred, with a small even margin; feet at the bottom centre. Anything described as being on the back of the outfit is not visible from this angle: do not turn the character to show it.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid magenta background (#FF00FF), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep magenta out of the character.

CONSTRAINTS: one character only. Square 1:1 image (1024 x 1024). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no ground shadow, no floor line, no props unless described.

Draw a full-body sprite of Pain (Chikushodo) for a 2D game, as a square 1:1 image.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 (Shippuden Naruto's sprite): the style and proportion reference ONLY: match its head size, line weight, cel shading and art style exactly. Do NOT copy its face, hair, outfit, colours or pose details; the character below is a different person.

STYLE: a frame from the Naruto TV anime of the late 2000s (Studio Pierrot's cel look). Flat saturated colours with two-tone cel shading: one flat shadow tone per colour with a hard edge, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no photo realism. Line work: clean near-black lines (#1A1410) at the anime's own weight for everything inside the figure (face, hair strands, clothing folds, hands). The outer outline, every edge where the figure meets the background (including the gaps between the arms and the body and between the legs), is slightly bolder, about 1.25 times the inner lines: firm, but not an obvious thick sticker outline. All lines near-black, never brown, red or purple, and never tinted by the background.

CHARACTER: Pain (the Animal Path) of the Akatsuki (Shippuden): a tall man with long spiky orange hair, purple ringed Rinnegan eyes and many black metal piercings on the nose and ears, a blank expression, a long black high-collared cloak patterned with red clouds outlined in white, a a forehead protector whose metal plate is engraved with the Hidden Rain Village symbol (four vertical falling lines) and scratched through with a horizontal gash (a rogue ninja).
Show the complete outfit exactly as the anime draws this character in this era, head to feet, including trousers or skirt and footwear. Expression: their typical expression in the anime, lips closed.

PROPORTIONS: Pain (Chikushodo) is 169 cm tall and drawn 4.9 heads tall (the head, chin to the top of the skull, not counting hair that sticks up, is 1/4.9 of the height from the soles to the top of the skull). The head is exactly as big as in Image 1; a taller character has a longer body and legs, not a bigger head. The build follows the anime (slim, broad, stocky or tall as the character is drawn there).

POSE AND FRAMING: full body, standing in a relaxed ready stance: feet apart, weight balanced, arms held slightly away from the body with loosely closed fists, so there is a clear gap between each arm and the hip. Three-quarter front view: the chest and shoulders face the viewer, the head and body turned toward the viewer's RIGHT (the visible ear on the left side of the face, the nose pointing right). Eye-level camera. The whole figure in frame from the top of the hair to the soles, centred, with a small even margin; feet at the bottom centre. Anything described as being on the back of the outfit is not visible from this angle: do not turn the character to show it.

BACKGROUND: a plain, perfectly flat, solid bright green background (#00FF00), one uniform colour from edge to edge, behind the whole character. No gradient, no shading, no scenery, no glow, no shadow. Keep bright green out of the character.

CONSTRAINTS: one character only. Square 1:1 image (1024 x 1024). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no ground shadow, no floor line, no props unless described.
